objective.name: reading.mark
objective.description: Advances the reading cursor of a reader on a conversation (a lineage), so that the interface can tell what is new; the cursor never moves back.

#root.role: Advance, in the reading_cursors Matter, the cursor of one reader on one lineage to the given line, never moving it back, creating the Matter on first use.

reader._comment: Optional. The reader; user:1 by default.

changed._comment: True when the cursor moved forward.

effects.cursors: Creates the reading_cursors Matter on first use and writes it when a cursor moves forward; writes nothing otherwise.

transformation_contract.morphing: A reader and the line up to which they have read a conversation become that reader's cursor on that conversation, moved forward only.
invariants: The cursor of a reader on a lineage never moves back: it becomes the greater of the stored value and seq.
A mark that does not move the cursor writes nothing.
The reading_cursors Matter is created empty on first use, in the same operation as the first mark.
A mark never touches the cursors of other lineages or of other readers.
Marks that arrive together are all kept: the write is guarded by expected_revision and retried on conflict.
The answer carries the cursor after the mark and whether it moved forward.
A mark requires the continuity it names to exist: a cursor never outlives the conversation it names, and a late mark of a conversation just deleted creates nothing.
success: The cursor of the reader on the lineage is at least seq.
failure: Fails with an invalid request when lineage_id or reader is empty or seq is not a non-negative integer, and writes nothing.
Fails not found when the continuity named by lineage_id does not exist, and writes nothing.
notes: What counts as new is decided by the interface, which compares the lines of a conversation with this cursor.

#ensure.role: Create the reading_cursors Matter, empty, when it does not exist.

transformation_contract.morphing: A missing Matter becomes an empty set of cursors.

#advance.role: Move the cursor forward under a guarded write.

transformation_contract.morphing: A cursor and a line become the greater of the two.
